description: Sellers: list your own agent-callable tool on the Dirtsmith rate sheet. Free, no login, no payment. Goes into a public pending queue labeled 'unverified, seller-submitted'. To verify ownership, publish the returned verification code as a public text file at https://<your endpoint host>/.well-known/dirtsmith-verify.txt, then call verify_my_listing. Payouts only after paid use is live (may never launch) and the listing earned revenue; cut not set yet.
name: list_my_tool
